text.arabic_uthmani: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَقُلْ أَنذَرْتُكُمْ صَٰعِقَةًۭ مِّثْلَ صَٰعِقَةِ عَادٍۢ وَثَمُودَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive-consequential connector opening a conditional refusal scenario from prior discourse
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the ayah begin as a continuation, not a cold start. It pulls the completed proof-sequence of 41:12 into the new conditional frame, so possible refusal is tested inside an argument already underway. Its pairing with the later {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) also lets the ear hear condition and response as a linked trigger-answer frame.

topics.headline: opening continuation into contingency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refusal condition answers prior proof rather than beginning a detached threat.
topics.reason: The first particle is prefixed to the conditional and attachment evidence places words 1-3 as the protasis, while boundary evidence ties the move to the prior ayah.

topics.headline: paired fa marks condition and answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two light {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) beats framing the condition and its commanded answer.
topics.reason: The second {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) at word 4 opens the apodosis, so the first and second particles form a local trigger-response pattern.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle that suspends the following perfect verb as a possible refusal scenario

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the apodosis connector fused to the imperative of saying

words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) keeps the turning-away from being asserted as a completed fact, even though the following perfect verb gives it a complete scenario-shape. The ayah therefore does not drift into general admonition: the particle starts a conditional mechanism whose answer is the commanded warning at {{ar:فَقُلْ}} ({{tr:fa-qul}}).

topics.headline: perfect action held inside condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that refusal is framed as a complete possible posture, not narrated as already accomplished fact.
topics.reason: The particle opens the protasis and governs the perfect verb that follows, so the event is complete in shape but conditional in assertion.

topics.headline: condition controls the warning command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speech command is triggered by a specified posture of aversion rather than placed randomly.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links words 1-3 with words 4-5 as condition and apodosis, preserving the scope of the warning command.

words.gloss_range: conditional Form IV turning-away, broadened by the omitted object into a posture of aversion
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes presenting, exposing, opposing, side/width imagery, and turning away; the local intransitive Form IV selects aversion while retaining side-turning pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following imperative of saying that answers the refusal condition

words.prose: {{ar:أَعْرَضُوا۟}} ({{tr:aʿraḍū}}) gives refusal a bodily orientation: the subjects produce distance by turning aside. Because no prepositional object is stated, the aversion is not narrowed to one explicit object; it becomes a posture toward the signs, speech, and warning field. Structurally, the act meant to avoid address becomes the condition that forces {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}), so turning away is answered by directed speech. Against the established cosmic ordering of 41:12, that possible human aversion feels sharply smaller and more culpable, and the rough guttural sound begins a tightening path toward the later shock noun.

topics.headline: plural perfect inside the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices collective refusal compressed inside the verb while still held inside the conditional frame.
topics.reason: The verb is 3mp perfect with no separate subject word, and {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) keeps it conditional rather than asserted.

topics.headline: omitted object broadens the turning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the turning is an orientation of refusal, not only avoidance of one named object.
topics.reason: The local frame is intransitive with no {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) complement, so the common object frame is not locally filled.

topics.headline: Form IV aversion with side-facing image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels refusal as self-produced side-turning, while local grammar keeps aversion as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The wider presentation and side field supplies image pressure, but the intransitive Form IV frame selects turning away rather than presentation or opposition as independent senses.

topics.headline: aversion answered by warning speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that turning away does not end discourse; it activates speech and warning as the accountable answer.
topics.reason: The local sequence places {{ar:أَعْرَضُوا۟}} ({{tr:aʿraḍū}}) before {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) and {{ar:أَنذَرْتُكُمْ}} ({{tr:andhartukum}}), matching the supplied warning-speech recurrence.

topics.headline: cosmic order cut to human aversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sharp movement from established cosmic ordering into possible human refusal.
topics.reason: The word is the first lexical action inside the conditional after the boundary from 41:12.

topics.headline: rough articulation supports aversion-to-shock movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a rough sound texture beginning to tighten toward the later shock noun.
topics.reason: The row is phonetic rather than grammatical, but it adds a distinct acoustic payoff tied to the local movement into {{ar:صَٰعِقَةً}} ({{tr:ṣāʿiqatan}}).

words.gloss_range: apodosis connector before an imperative, marking the warning command as the answer to refusal

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the imperative of saying attached to this response particle

words.prose: The second {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the condition into response. Because it is attached to {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}), the command is heard as therefore say, not as an isolated instruction; the ayah moves with no gap from possible aversion to mandated proclamation. Together with the first {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), it makes the ayah linked backward into prior proof and driven forward into the warning response.

topics.headline: conditional answer before imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command to speak is grammatically dependent on the refusal condition.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies words 4-5 as the apodosis before an imperative, so the particle marks answer and consequence.

topics.headline: two fa particles frame trigger and response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah linked backward by the first {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) and driven forward by the second.
topics.reason: The repeated particle bookends the local conditional mechanism: {{ar:فَإِنْ}} ({{tr:fa-in}}) opens the contingency and {{ar:فَقُلْ}} ({{tr:fa-qul}}) opens the answer.

words.gloss_range: bare Form I imperative of saying, functioning as the conditional answer and governing quoted warning speech
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers saying, statement, attribution, and speech exchange; the local imperative selects direct authorized utterance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second person masculine plural object suffix marking the warning recipients
the completed warning statement governed by the imperative

words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) makes speech the required response to refusal. The command is short and direct, with its singular commanded speaker distinguished from the plural recipients later marked by {{ar:-كُمْ}} ({{tr:-kum}}). It does not merely introduce information; it governs a completed warning claim, {{ar:أَنذَرْتُكُمْ}} ({{tr:andhartukum}}), so the liability is voiced as already standing. That marks a surah-local shift from explaining messenger status in 41:6 to delivering completed warning here, and the clipped command-beat interrupts aversion before the longer notice arrives.

topics.headline: commanded speech as response to refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that refusal produces declaration, not silence.
topics.reason: The imperative is the apodosis of the conditional and governs the quoted warning sentence.

topics.headline: qawl selects public utterance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that warning becomes accountable through articulated speech, not inward knowledge or rumor.
topics.reason: The q-w-l field is narrowed locally to direct saying, and the quoted complement makes the warning a performed utterance.

topics.headline: clipped imperative interrupts aversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the short command-beat arrest the movement before the longer warning statement.
topics.reason: The Form I imperative is short and apocopated, attached to the apodosis particle and placed between the refusal condition and the warning quote.

topics.headline: commanded saying joins warning formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a surah-local shift from explaining messenger status (41:6) to delivering completed warning here.
topics.reason: The supplied parallels link q-w-l with warning language, including the shift from direct warning command (74:2) to saying that warning has been completed.

topics.headline: imperative embeds completed warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command transmits completed notice rather than opening negotiation.
topics.reason: The quoted complement begins with a perfect verb, so the command orders announcement of a warning that already stands.

words.gloss_range: completed Form IV warning addressed from a first-person speaker to plural recipients, with the warned danger supplied next
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes warning, alarm, notice before danger, and vow or obligation pressure; local Form IV selects caused warning-awareness and accountable notice

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second person masculine plural object suffix attached to the warning verb
the explicit danger warned of by the verb

words.prose: {{ar:أَنذَرْتُكُمْ}} ({{tr:andhartukum}}) is not a promise to warn later. The perfect inside the commanded quote declares that notice already stands, while the attached {{ar:-كُمْ}} ({{tr:-kum}}) builds the plural audience into the warning act. The verb then takes {{ar:صَٰعِقَةً}} ({{tr:ṣāʿiqatan}}) as the specified danger, so accountability is placed before the shock noun lands. The vow-and-warning family makes that notice feel binding, and the surah warning role named earlier becomes direct completed address here.

topics.headline: perfect warning enacted in quoted speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the utterance declares completed notice and performs that notice before the addressees.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect inside the commanded quotation, so the speech both reports and enacts warning status.

topics.headline: 1s-to-2mp warning frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is grammatically attached to the warning, not merely mentioned nearby.
topics.reason: The verb carries a first-person speaker and a second masculine plural object suffix, while the explicit danger follows as another object in the warning frame.

topics.headline: n-dh-r notice with binding pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels warning as responsibility-creating notice, while local Form IV keeps warning-awareness as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The vow/obligation family adds pressure, but the Form IV verb with recipients selects warning rather than a vow act.

topics.headline: mission warning becomes completed address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the warning role named earlier in the surah becoming a direct completed address here.
topics.reason: The supplied evidence links warning language at 41:4 and direct warning command at 74:2 with this perfect warning statement.

topics.headline: warning precedes specified danger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accountability arrives before the catastrophic noun, and the sentence then narrows the danger by analogy.
topics.reason: The verb governs {{ar:صَٰعِقَةً}} ({{tr:ṣāʿiqatan}}), which is then qualified by {{ar:مِثْلَ}} ({{tr:mithla}}), creating notice-to-danger-to-precedent order.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative shock-strike as the warned object, then qualified by likeness to historical precedent
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes stunning, overpowering shock, collapse, and thunderbolt-like strike; the local noun selects a catastrophic shock event or strike

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following comparison marker that classifies the warned shock
accepted variant event-noun form for the same shock field

words.prose: {{ar:صَٰعِقَةً}} ({{tr:ṣāʿiqatan}}) gives the warning a concrete object before history explains its class. Its indefiniteness lets the danger land broadly and formidably, then {{ar:مِثْلَ}} ({{tr:mithla}}) narrows it toward the precedent phrase. The shock-root makes the danger feel like overpowering strike and collapse; the accepted {{ar:صَعْقَةً}} ({{tr:ṣaʿqatan}}) reading keeps the same field while foregrounding the experienced event. Its marked shock vocabulary points toward same-surah specification at 41:17, and the emphatic, guttural, and back consonants make that constriction audible.

topics.headline: indefinite accusative warning object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the danger is grammatically named before it is historically classified.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the explicit thing warned of, indefinite at first, and qualified by the following comparison phrase.

topics.headline: ṣāʿiqa as overpowering shock
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the threat as sudden overpowering shock and collapse, while the variant only shifts emphasis within the same danger field.
topics.reason: The local noun selects the shock-strike field; the {{ar:صَعْقَةً}} ({{tr:ṣaʿqatan}}) variant emphasizes event-collapse without changing the warned referent.

topics.headline: rare shock root as salient threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning uses marked shock language, with same-surah specification coming at 41:17.
topics.reason: The supplied occurrence field is small and includes parallels at 2:55 and 4:153, while 41:17 later specifies the shock-punishment wording.

topics.headline: first shock noun moves toward precedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first shock noun as open threat and the second as the indexed precedent that explains it.
topics.reason: The repeated noun is mediated by {{ar:مِثْلَ}} ({{tr:mithla}}), so the first occurrence is not redundant but the target of comparison.

topics.headline: heavy consonants enact shock pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the emphatic and guttural consonants tightening around the meaning of shock.
topics.reason: The sound row gives a distinct acoustic payoff tied to this surface form and the local warning field.

words.gloss_range: accusative noun of likeness that classifies the warned shock by comparison to the following precedent phrase
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers likeness, example, representation, and parable-making; the local noun selects class-equivalence and precedent analogy

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first shock noun that serves as the comparison target
the precedent phrase that supplies the comparison standard

words.prose: {{ar:مِثْلَ}} ({{tr:mithla}}) is the hinge that keeps the warning from ending as raw threat. It attaches the indefinite {{ar:صَٰعِقَةً}} ({{tr:ṣāʿiqatan}}) to {{ar:صَٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَثَمُودَ}} ({{tr:ṣāʿiqati ʿĀdin wa-Thamūda}}), turning remembered disaster into the measure of the present warning. Its likeness is not a loose illustration; it places the danger in the same catastrophe class. The same surah has already used likeness for messenger explanation in 41:6; here the analogy thread shifts to catastrophe, while the tanwīn-to-mīm sound welds the open threat into its comparison.

topics.headline: mithla locks target to standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two shock nouns form a controlled comparison rather than two separate objects.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:مِثْلَ}} ({{tr:mithla}}) qualify the first shock noun and govern the genitive standard that follows.

topics.headline: likeness as disaster class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices memory becoming a model by which current danger is measured.
topics.reason: The m-th-l range includes likeness and example-making; locally the comparison applies that logic to a disaster precedent, not to a narrated parable.

topics.headline: likeness shifts rhetorical target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the surah moving from messenger likeness (41:6) to catastrophe likeness here.
topics.reason: Same-surah and co-occurrence evidence supports an analogy thread, while local grammar keeps this occurrence tied to the shock comparison.

topics.headline: bridge from open threat to named archive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closing through historical recognition rather than generic danger.
topics.reason: The word sits between the first shock noun and the named peoples, converting threat into precedent-framed warning.

topics.headline: sound welds threat to comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the tanwīn-to-mīm transition joining the threat to its comparison phrase.
topics.reason: The recitational sound row adds a distinct payoff that reinforces the syntactic attachment.

words.gloss_range: construct-state shock noun that supplies the precedent standard and is identified by the following people name
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes stunning, overpowering shock, collapse, and thunderbolt-like strike; the local construct noun selects an archived disaster event

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the proper name identifying the construct disaster
the first shock noun explained by this construct precedent
the coordinated second people joining the same precedent field

words.prose: The second {{ar:صَٰعِقَةِ}} ({{tr:ṣāʿiqati}}) no longer floats as an indefinite threat. In construct, it becomes the remembered disaster of {{ar:عَادٍ}} ({{tr:ʿĀdin}}), the standard by which the first {{ar:صَٰعِقَةً}} ({{tr:ṣāʿiqatan}}) is understood. The phrase compresses a historical outcome into a shock-signature and then leaves room for {{ar:ثَمُودَ}} ({{tr:Thamūda}}) to join the same precedent field. It also anticipates later same-surah punishment details at 41:16 and 41:17, while the construct recitation makes disaster and people sound inseparable.

topics.headline: construct shock noun identified by ʿĀd
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second shock noun is a known precedent, not a repeated vague threat.
topics.reason: The noun is the genitive complement of {{ar:مِثْلَ}} ({{tr:mithla}}) and a construct head governing {{ar:عَادٍ}} ({{tr:ʿĀdin}}).

topics.headline: shock image stores historical memory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the disaster image stand for the remembered people, while the variant stays within the same shock-event field.
topics.reason: The construct phrase selects the historical event sense; root shock and the {{ar:صَعْقَةِ}} ({{tr:ṣaʿqati}}) variant add event pressure without changing the reference.

topics.headline: shock heading anticipates later details
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 41:13 condensing punishment details that later unfold within the surah, including 41:16 and 41:17.
topics.reason: Same-surah evidence links the shock field with later punishment wording, while the local construct begins the precedent field.

topics.headline: second occurrence explains the first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a movement from indefinite warned event to genitive precedent.
topics.reason: The second occurrence answers the first through construct specification rather than duplicating it.

topics.headline: recitation fuses disaster with name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the people and disaster run together as one indexed precedent.
topics.reason: The sound row reinforces the construct relation by making the phrase feel tightly joined.

words.gloss_range: genitive proper name identifying the shock-precedent and opening the paired ʿĀd-Thamūd warning dyad
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes returning, repeating, restoration, and habitual recurrence, but the local word functions first as a proper name with uncertain derivation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the construct shock noun governed by the comparison phrase
the coordinated second people in the closing dyad

words.prose: {{ar:عَادٍ}} ({{tr:ʿĀdin}}) identifies the disaster by a known people, not by an abstract label. Its genitive case makes the name the key to {{ar:صَٰعِقَةِ}} ({{tr:ṣāʿiqati}}), while the following coordination opens a two-name archive with {{ar:ثَمُودَ}} ({{tr:Thamūda}}). Any return-root pressure remains secondary: it can support the logic of recurrence, but the local force is historical named precedent. The name also anticipates its fuller same-surah elaboration at 41:15, and the long-vowel balance with the second name gives the closing pair acoustic symmetry.

topics.headline: proper name identifies the disaster
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the catastrophe being indexed by a known community rather than left as an abstract event.
topics.reason: The proper noun is genitive after the construct shock noun and supplies definite historical reference without {{ar:ال}} ({{tr:al}}).

topics.headline: proper name over return-root play
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the name as historical referent while allowing recurrence pressure to support the warning logic.
topics.reason: The evidence reports uncertain derivation; root recurrence can color analogy but cannot replace the proper-name reference.

topics.headline: ʿĀd opens recognized pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first name opens a familiar warning catalogue, with same-surah elaboration at 41:15.
topics.reason: The supplied evidence shows repeated pairing with Thamūd and nearby recurrence at 41:15, so the name functions as a compressed archive cue.

topics.headline: first anchor of final precedent slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closing on named communal consequence rather than on bare danger.
topics.reason: The name is the first proper noun after the comparison marker and prepares the coordinated second name.

topics.headline: long-vowel balance in the dyad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two names balanced acoustically before the archive function is complete.
topics.reason: The cadence row contributes a distinct sound payoff tied to the closing pair.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction attaching Thamūd to ʿĀd under the same precedent comparison

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the second proper name coordinated under the same comparison
the first proper name in the closing precedent dyad

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does more than add another name. It keeps {{ar:ثَمُودَ}} ({{tr:Thamūda}}) under the same construct comparison already formed with {{ar:عَادٍ}} ({{tr:ʿĀdin}}), so the closure widens one precedent phrase rather than starting a second threat. The small conjunction turns a single named case into a compact two-history warning class. Its light onset releases the phrase into the heavier final name, letting closure weight land there while the two peoples remain joined.

topics.headline: wa coordinates Thamūd under same comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Thamūd joining the same disaster comparison, not a separate warning.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates {{ar:ثَمُودَ}} ({{tr:Thamūda}}) with {{ar:عَادٍ}} ({{tr:ʿĀdin}}) under the same phrase.

topics.headline: conjunction expands one precedent into a dyad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the warning gaining breadth without retelling either history.
topics.reason: The phrase is meaningful after {{ar:عَادٍ}} ({{tr:ʿĀdin}}), but the conjunction extends it cumulatively into a recognized pair.

topics.headline: short wa releases into heavier final name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final name land with closure weight while remaining joined to the first.
topics.reason: The phonetic row adds a distinct cadence payoff at the ayah close.

words.gloss_range: proper name coordinated with ʿĀd, completing the historical precedent dyad with visible case-reading pressure
words.root_gloss_range: root or name evidence is uncertain; the local force is overwhelmingly the proper name Thamūd as a collective historical precedent, not a productive root derivation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accepted variant form that overtly marks the shared genitive coordination

words.prose: {{ar:ثَمُودَ}} ({{tr:Thamūda}}) completes the comparison on a second named community. The surface can be heard with proper-name case pressure, and the {{ar:ثَمُودٍ}} ({{tr:Thamūdin}}) reading makes the shared genitive coordination explicit; either way, the people remain the same precedent. The ayah therefore ends not on abstract disaster but on a repeated communal outcome, with denial at 91:11 and refused guidance by Thamūd made explicit at 41:17. In the {{ar:ثَمُودٍ}} ({{tr:Thamūdin}}) reading, the tanwīn cadence also matches the first name, making the pair acoustically parallel as well as syntactically coordinated.

topics.headline: base form and variant expose shared genitive role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Thamūd shares the same governed precedent phrase, with the variant making that relation clearer.
topics.reason: The base form can function as diptote genitive or name-form, while the {{ar:ثَمُودٍ}} ({{tr:Thamūdin}}) variant overtly marks genitive coordination with {{ar:عَادٍ}} ({{tr:ʿĀdin}}).

topics.headline: historical index over uncertain derivation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps Thamūd as collective memory and warning precedent rather than treating the name as transparent root play.
topics.reason: The proper-name evidence is dominant and derivation is uncertain, so local meaning comes through historical reference and catalogue membership.

topics.headline: Thamūd completes ʿĀd-Thamūd archive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final name as the endpoint of a recognized warning catalogue, not a disconnected second item.
topics.reason: The supplied evidence gives repeated ʿĀd-Thamūd pairings, plus same-surah Thamūd material at 41:17 and denial evidence at 91:11.

topics.headline: ayah closes on repeated communal outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah ending on the second precedent, making repeated outcome the last heard element.
topics.reason: The word is final and coordinated with the first name under one comparison phrase, completing a two-case architecture.

topics.headline: variant makes paired names acoustically parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears how the {{ar:ثَمُودٍ}} ({{tr:Thamūdin}}) reading can match {{ar:عَادٍ}} ({{tr:ʿĀdin}}) in tanwīn cadence.
topics.reason: The accepted reading supplies an acoustic as well as syntactic payoff without changing the named referent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional sequence "فإن أعرضوا فقل أنذرتكم" joins إعراض at word 2 to commanded قول and completed warning at words 3-4.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bodily side-turn away from an offered address triggers an overt counter-address: danger must be externalized in words so refusal cannot be confused with nondelivery.

activation_trace.role: Turning the side supplies active disengagement and makes the condition a failure of reception.
Produced speech makes the response overt and publicly deliverable.
Fear-bearing notice supplies an advance alarm intended to awaken caution.

changed_reading.after: The ayah marks a communicative checkpoint: after active side-turning, the messenger must state that the danger has already been made known.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The commanded utterance "فقل" and warning "أنذرتكم" immediately introduce the twice-repeated صاعقة.
baseline_models.mechanism: The warning can traverse the same auditory channel as one branch of the catastrophe: an intelligible spoken alarm arrives before an overwhelming upper crash. The first sound can awaken caution; refusal leaves the second.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the first, intelligible sound in the sequence.
Advance warning gives that first sound a protective opportunity.
The severe-sound image makes the threatened event an unmanageable acoustic counterpart to the spoken alarm.
The upper crash keeps the acoustic model attached to an atmospheric strike, impact, and possible death.

changed_reading.before: The messenger reports a future lightning-like disaster.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages two sounds: a survivable voiced warning prefigures the devastating crash it names.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "مثل صاعقة عاد وثمود" makes two named precedents the comparator for the threatened event.
baseline_models.mechanism: Similarity turns prior catastrophes into a transferable pattern, while the lesson/exemplar branch makes those cases deterrent objects for present hearers rather than historical ornament.

activation_trace.role: General similarity bridges the threatened event to the two earlier instances.
The lesson-sign image makes the comparison function as a present warning.
The proper-name branch fixes Aad as a concrete historical member of the comparison.

changed_reading.before: Aad and Thamud are historical examples of the same disaster.
changed_reading.after: Their cases are reusable precedents: the present warning predicts an analogous function and outcome, without yet requiring an identical physical instrument.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early context repeats warning followed by side-turning and then distributes failed uptake across hearing, heart-cover, ear-weight, and an interpersonal barrier. The focus condition therefore follows layered closure, not unclear transmission.

activation_trace.role: The focus side-turn is the action whose reception mechanism the context expands.
The focus warning remains an advance attempt to awaken caution.
The earlier warning immediately precedes the same side-turn, establishing the repeated sequence.
Repeated bodily turning shows a sustained response pattern rather than a momentary misunderstanding.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies the failed function, not merely absent sound.
A protecting cover over the heart supplies an inner layer of closure.
Weight in the ear supplies a sensory layer that blocks uptake.
Prevention of access supplies the declared relational barrier between speaker and hearers.

structural_cues: 41:4 orders warning, side-turning, and non-hearing in the same sequence compressed by 41:13.
41:5 distributes refusal across inner, sensory, and interpersonal interfaces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated sequence and bodily barriers; I read them as coordinated modes of refusal causing failed uptake, while literal or involuntary incapacity remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The addressees simply decline a warning.
changed_reading.after: The focus conditional marks a completed reception breakdown after warning has crossed several interfaces; catastrophe is not compensation for unclear speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence presents straightness, anchoring, measurement, willing compliance, and completed execution. Against that ordered field, the focus strike reads as a bounded consequence of persistent disalignment rather than an outbreak of arbitrary disorder.

activation_trace.role: Side-turning supplies the human departure from the ordered direction developed in context.
The upper crash is recast as an intervention within the ordered cosmos rather than chaos outside it.
Straightness and balance provide the explicit directional counterpart to turning aside.
Firm anchoring makes stability a constructed feature of the world.
Measured planning supplies deliberate calibration rather than random force.
Willing compliance gives creation a responsive orientation that contrasts with human side-turning.
Completed and effective execution closes the ordered sequence and makes consequences executable.

structural_cues: 41:6-12 moves from a command to straighten through measured earth and compliant sky to completed arrangement.
41:13 begins only after that ordered construction has been established.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic order and human straightening; I infer a normative analogy between that order and the focus refusal, while the creation sequence may alternatively establish power without specifying a moral mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The thunderbolt is a sudden disaster imposed after rejection.
changed_reading.after: It is a calibrated boundary-event inside a measured order whose stability has been persistently refused.

context_deltas.mechanism: Aad's self-magnifying force claim meets a wind, whereas Thamud's preference for blindness after guidance meets the explicitly named blast; a protected group is then separated out. The focus likeness therefore joins causal structure and terminal overthrow, not necessarily one identical material instrument.

activation_trace.role: Similarity opens the question of which functional features the two cases share.
The focus upper crash names the shared catastrophic category whose embodiments the context differentiates.
Self-greatness supplies Aad's social posture of superiority.
Strength gathered like cord-strands supplies the force Aad claims and the force their outcome answers.
Literal wind gives Aad's catastrophe a materially distinct embodiment.
Gentle direction to a true path establishes that Thamud's alternative was made available.
Intense preference makes their blindness selected rather than merely suffered.
Blindness of insight specifies Thamud's failure mode.
The named upper crash explicitly realizes the focus category in Thamud's case.
Rescue by separation shows that the event draws a boundary rather than consuming everyone indiscriminately.
Protective avoidance supplies the preserved group's side of that discriminating boundary.

structural_cues: 41:15-17 differentiates Aad and Thamud by posture and material outcome before 41:18 marks rescue.
The same focus category spans wind for one people and an explicitly named blast for the other.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct failures, instruments, and a rescued group; I infer that "مثل" compares a causal and discriminating pattern, while strict physical similarity remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The focus predicts the same lightning-like weapon previously used twice.
changed_reading.after: It predicts the same patterned overthrow: a response fitted to a chosen failure and bounded so that protected hearers can be separated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning becomes advance notice in a later evidentiary chain: recipients are gathered, their own faculties testify and speak, attempted concealment fails, and a governing assumption is named as ruinous. Completed "أنذرتكم" therefore carries accountability as well as prediction.

activation_trace.role: Overt speech makes the focus warning available as public notice.
Advance alarm supplies the notice whose later reception can be assessed.
Gathering and driving a group to a destination opens the later hearing-like proceeding.
Knowledge-bearing testimony gives the bodily disclosures evidentiary force.
The faculty that earlier refused sound becomes a witness to what it received.
The body's outer covering becomes an intimate record rather than a successful screen.
Made speech turns the embodied record into articulated testimony.
Failed covering shows that the reception history cannot finally be concealed.
Unsecured supposition identifies the assumption under which the warning was discounted.
Falling into destruction supplies the causal endpoint assigned to that assumption.

structural_cues: 41:19-23 proceeds from gathering to bodily testimony, questioning, failed concealment, and a ruin-producing assumption.
Hearing shifts from the blocked reception of 41:4-5 to a witness in 41:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies notice, gathering, testimony, speaking bodies, and ruin through assumption; I infer a juridical link between prior warning and later evidence, while the witnesses could alternatively establish deeds independently of the notice.

changed_reading.before: The focus utterance forecasts an event.
changed_reading.after: It also performs accountable notice: the hearers' later record can show that catastrophe was preceded by an intelligible alarm.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opponents attempt to win by noisy interference against recitation. The focus's ordered "say" and the severe-sound branch of صاعقة reverse that contest: a human utterance can be socially drowned out, but the terminal sound it warns of cannot be overpowered.

activation_trace.role: The commanded utterance supplies ordered, intelligible speech on one side of the acoustic contest.
Severe sound supplies the overwhelming reversal of attempted vocal suppression.
Their own articulated command organizes resistance to the recited speech.
Refusal to hear as understand or comply makes non-reception an explicit tactic.
Recitation identifies the meaningful sound their tactic targets.
Mixed noisy clamor supplies the interference mechanism.
Overpowering force states the intended outcome of the noise campaign.

structural_cues: 41:26 explicitly sequences a command not to hear, noisy interference, and the aim of overpowering.
The focus likewise sequences commanded speech and a catastrophe whose branch inventory includes severe sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate clamor and the severe-sound branch; I infer an ironic acoustic reversal, while the focus صاعقة may primarily foreground atmospheric impact rather than sound.

changed_reading.before: The thunderbolt is only the object described by a warning.
changed_reading.after: It is also the endpoint of a failed acoustic strategy: those who try to overpower meaningful speech are warned of a sound they cannot overpower.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah supplies a symmetric alternative to side-turning: verbal affirmation and straightness receive a benign descent, while better speech and repulsion can convert an enemy into a close ally. The focus warning is therefore a branch point aimed at reorientation, not a declaration of fixed doom.

activation_trace.role: Turning the side supplies the conditional path whose alternative the later context displays.
Warning remains an attempt to awaken caution before the threatened path closes.
An articulated affirmation supplies a receptive use of speech opposite to refusal.
Straightness and balance supply the directional counter-action to side-turning.
A benign descent onto the steadfast contrasts with the focus upper crash.
Calling by speech supplies an outward invitation rather than acoustic domination.
Safety from impairment gives the call's declared orientation.
Repelling harm supplies an active but non-catastrophic way to redirect conflict.
Enmity identifies the hostile relation available for transformation.
Near friendship and support supply the transformed relational endpoint.

structural_cues: 41:30 sequences verbal affirmation, straightness, and angelic descent.
41:33-34 sequences good speech, active repulsion, and enemy-to-friend reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a conditional focus and later counterpaths; I infer that they remain live alternatives to the warned outcome, while the later passages may address a distinct group rather than reopen this exact moment.

changed_reading.before: The conditional introduces an effectively fatal decree for rejecters.
changed_reading.after: It marks a live fork: the alarm seeks a counter-turn toward straightness and even relational repair before catastrophic descent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning the side expands into attempted positional escape through distant schism, but the closing sequence locates signs across far horizons and inner selves within comprehensive knowledge. The threatened event becomes one possible manifestation of an evidentiary field from which orientation creates no outside.

activation_trace.role: Side-turning supplies the focus attempt to relocate oneself relative to the address.
A group fissured by opposition expands the individual turn into a social split.
Distance supplies the imagined remoteness from the claim being resisted.

structural_cues: 41:52 moves from denial to distant schism; 41:53 answers with signs in horizons and selves.
41:54 closes the surah with comprehensive encompassing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies side, fissure, distance, outer horizons, inner selves, and encompassing; I infer a continuous spatial model, while the final encompassing may be solely epistemic and not itself punitive.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is a private refusal to face the warning.
changed_reading.after: It is an attempted positional escape inside a field whose evidence reaches both outer horizon and inner self; changing one's side creates no outside.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because عاد is a proper name and B012 controls its ordinary reading. It remains packet-anchored because the same focus token is mapped to the return branch while مثل explicitly authorizes recurrence. Downstream prose should render it only as a root-image echo in which a prior pattern "returns," never as the lexical translation of Aad.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "مثل صاعقة عاد" combines the comparator at word 6 with the QAC-mapped ع و د token at word 8.

activation_trace.role: Similarity provides the legitimate bridge by which a former pattern can recur.
The proper-name branch contains the lexical reading firmly as Aad.
Return after departure supplies the exploratory echo of catastrophe coming back as a pattern.

changed_reading.before: Aad is only one named historical comparator.
changed_reading.after: At the contained root-image level, naming Aad also lets the compared catastrophe feel like a prior configuration returning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the 41:51 occurrence record bundles verbal أعرض and adjectival عريض, and the connection is paronomastic rather than syntactic identity. It remains valid because both resolve to the focus root inventory while نأى and جانب literalize the side-turn and مس supplies the reversal trigger. Downstream prose should qualify it as an intratextual wordplay possibility.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus إعراض at 41:13 word 2 is reactivated by the paired ع ر ض forms and bodily side-language of 41:51.

activation_trace.role: The focus turning of the side supplies the initial compressed orientation.
The bundled occurrence repeats active side-turning under ease.
The same occurrence record includes broad prayer, supplying the breadth endpoint of the reversal.
Distancing by the side physically elaborates what إعراض does.
The body's side makes the orientation image concrete.
The impact of harm supplies the trigger that changes the person's orientation.
Calling by speech supplies the outward activity that becomes broad after harm.

changed_reading.before: Side-turning simply triggers the threatened consequence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the consequence exposes an unstable orientation: the person who narrows into a turned side under ease expands into prolonged calling when harm touches.

strongest_changes: The repeated barrier vocabulary makes the focus condition a response to engineered non-reception, not to inadequate delivery.
Aad and Thamud revise likeness from one identical weapon to a shared causal, terminal, and discriminating pattern with different embodiments.
Bodily testimony turns the warning into accountable public notice, while the noise campaign makes the severe-sound branch an acoustic reversal.
Straight speech, straightness, benign descent, and enemy-to-friend transformation keep a counterpath open inside the focus conditional.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly reactivated the focus's speech/hearing, side/orientation, likeness, and severe-sound mechanisms across creation order, historical cases, bodily testimony, acoustic opposition, relational repair, and the horizon-to-self closure.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the severe-sound branch or the atmospheric-impact branch should dominate the rendering of صاعقة.
Whether مثل primarily permits functional analogy across wind and blast or still requires closer physical similarity.
Whether the Aad-return and side-to-breadth echoes deserve prose rendering or should remain contained as exploratory wordplay.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Refused reception returns as overwhelming sound.** **ع ر ض B005** gives turning one's side away, **ن ذ ر B001** warning that awakens caution, and **ص ع ق B001/B002** a harsh piercing sound and a sky-borne thunderbolt. The sequence begins with turning from speech and ends with a sound-event that cannot be managed as ordinary speech. I infer a reversal: rejected warning returns in a materially coercive register. The thunderbolt is therefore not only penalty but failed audition made external.
2. **Likeness as a repeatable pattern.** **م ث ل B001** supplies likeness and **م ث ل B011** lesson or sign; **ع و د B004** contributes practiced repetition alongside its proper-name branch **ع و د B012** for Aad. I infer that the named histories function as repeatable causal models. The threat reads as activation of a known pattern, not mere comparison of intensities.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:20–22 makes hearing testify, and 41:26 commands listeners to drown recitation in noise. Those later ayat sharpen the sound-reversal: the community tries to control the auditory field, but the warning returns as an uncontrollable auditory and physical event.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A warning backed by repeatable precedent.** Lexically, `ن ذ ر B001` is warning that awakens caution, `ص ع ق B002` the sky-borne thunderbolt, and the dormant `م ث ل B002` is exemplary punishment made into a warning example. Structurally, the conditional repeats the turning-away of 41:4, then 41:15–17 unpack the two named precedents as boast, wind, chosen blindness, and seizure. I assign the comparison the role of converting a threatened event into a historical pattern and the thunderbolt the role of an abrupt system-level interruption. The abductive move is that matched refusal licenses expectation of matched consequence. The ayah reads as analogical risk disclosure, not an ungrounded threat.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:16–17 instantiate both sides of the comparison: wind answers ʿĀd and a thunderbolt takes Thamūd. Their different material routes but matched outcome strengthened `مثل` as exemplary pattern rather than exact physical duplication.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Knowledge moves from a hidden source into a joined, segmented, readable, and publicly voiced form.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Revelation materializes as a stitched and gathered artifact whose inner inscription is converted into carried speech.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hidden Inscription Becomes Carried Address
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Concealed knowledge is inscribed, delivered downward, carried by a messenger, and differentiated as welcome or warning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hidden transmission of knowledge `quranic:root_001633:B001/m01`; writing and engraving `quranic:root_001633:B003/m01`; divine inspiration and report `quranic:root_001633:B004/m01`; descending delivery of revelation `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; messenger and carried message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; spoken utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; glad-news proclamation `quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`; danger-warning that awakens caution `quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The channel begins with communication that is hidden, gestural, or engraved and ends with an audible human address. Descent and messenger-bearing form the transfer mechanism, while good news and warning are the two public effects of the same dispatched knowledge.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Access is blocked by nested coverings and burdens that run from the inner core to the outer senses.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Refusal becomes both architecture and body mechanics: an enclosed heart lies behind a diaphragm-like partition while an overloaded ear and turned flank close the approach.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Loaded Ear and Averted Side
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The auditory opening is loaded until acceptance fails, while the body presents its side and withdraws.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ear as bodily opening `quranic:root_000022:B001/m01`; listening that accepts what is heard `quranic:root_000022:B002/m01`; auditory perception `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`; understanding and compliance through hearing `quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`; heaviness lodged in the ear `quranic:root_001674:B001/m01`; heavy carried load `quranic:root_001674:B002/m01`; turning away by presenting the side `quranic:root_001001:B005/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The same lexical field makes hearing both a physical aperture and an act of obedient uptake. Weight disables that uptake, and the turned side completes the bodily withdrawal.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A meteorological strike crosses hearing, bodily sensation, and social standing to execute judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The punishment is not one image but a sensory sequence of cry, cold, haze, taste, and public abasement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Acoustic Cold Front
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A severe sound descends with a frigid wind, shocks its hearers, and drives a dust-darkened front.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: violent animal-like cry `quranic:root_000864:B001/m01`; upper-world thunderclap `quranic:root_000864:B002/m01`; stunned or dead victim `quranic:root_000864:B003/m01`; shrill rasping sound `quranic:root_000857:B002/m01`; frigid gale `quranic:root_000857:B004/m01`; cold ill-omened wind `quranic:root_001480:B002/m01`; drought-dust driven into the air `quranic:root_001480:B003/m01`; wind as overpowering force `quranic:root_000609:B011/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The thunderclap is at once sound, atmospheric blow, and cause of stunned collapse. Cold wind and driven dust extend the strike from an instant of noise into a sustained weather front.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, uzunluğa karşıt olan en ölçüsünü ve bir şeyin yanını aynı anlam alanında açıkça verir. Bir şeyi enli kılma da bu uzamsal çekirdeğin ettirgen gerçekleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, gösterme veya yüz çevirme eylemlerini değil, en boyutunu ve yan tarafı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın uzamsal anlamıyla sınırlıdır; özel tamlamalardan başka bir anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin uzunluğuna dik uzanan en boyutu ya da bu boyutun belirlediği yan taraf; ayrıca bir şeyi bu yönde geniş duruma getirmedir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin uzunluğuna karşıt en boyutunu belirtir.
En boyutunun belirlediği yan veya taraf için de kullanılır.
Bir şeyi enli duruma getirme işlemini de kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, uzunluğa karşıt en boyutu ile bu boyuta bağlı yan kavramıdır; niteleme ve ettirgenleştirme de bu çekirdeğe dayanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: En boyutunu, bu boyuta bağlı yanı ve ettirgen genişletmeyi birlikte anlatan genel açıklama olarak uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Uzamsal karşıtlığı, yan ilişkisini ve ettirgen işlemi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin ölçüsü veya yan yüzü söz konusu olduğunda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: En ölçüsünü ve yan taraf ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi enli kılma işlemini belirtmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin uzaktan veya bir yönden belirip görünmesini ve bu görünüşün bulut gibi beliren bir varlık adı olmasını destekler. Burada görünme, başkasının sergileme eyleminden bağımsızdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir failin sunduğu nesneyi değil, göz önünde beliren şeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın belirme ve görünme anlamıyla sınırlıdır; sunma yapılarına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin uzaktan veya belli bir yönden göz önünde belirmesi; ayrıca ufukta genişçe görünen bulut, çekirge sürüsü ya da dağ gibi belirgin oluşumdur.

facets.statement: Bir şey, bakan kişiye uzaktan veya bir yönden belirip görünür.
Ufukta beliren bulut başta olmak üzere geniş görünen oluşumun adı olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, bir şeyin bakana doğru bir yönden belirip görünmesidir; bulut bu görünüşün öne çıkan özel adlandırmasıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem görünme olayını hem de özellikle ufukta beliren oluşumu birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Kendiliğinden belirmeyi, yönü ve beliren varlık kullanımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin bakış alanında uzaktan belirdiği olay bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaktan belirme olayını doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Beliren bulut veya başka oluşumun ad olarak kullanımını vermez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: uzaktan beliren oluşum; özellikle bulut kümesi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal uzaktan veya bir yönden beliren oluşumu, özellikle bulutu adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi başkasına görünür kılma ettirgenliğini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin gizlilikten ya da görünmezlikten çıkıp görünmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yönlü ve uzaktan belirmeye, ayrıca beliren oluşuma bağlıdır; komşu dal daha genel görünme ve görünür kılma alanını kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kendiliğinden belirme ile genel görünme arasındaki sınırı en iyi gösteren aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما بدا وظهر للإنسان، وما استقبل من بعيد، والسحاب العارض، والجراد الكثير الذي يملأ الأفق، والجبل أو الشيء البادي عرضه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه العرض بفعل مبرز للغير، ولا الإعراض بمعنى التولي.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أعرض لك الشيء من بعيد إذا ظهر لك وبدا (maqayis)؛ عرض له أمر كذا أي ظهر (sihah)؛ أعرض لك الشيء أي بدا وظهر (tahdhib)؛ العارض البادي عرضه وتارة يخص بالسحاب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi araya girme, önünü kesme ve engel olma çekirdeğini doğrular; ayrıca işe kendini sokma ve insanları ayrım gözetmeden öldürme gibi yapılara uzanır. Bu yüzden dal yalnızca yoldaki fiziksel karşılaşma diye daraltılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek araya girip engel oluşturmadır; müdahale ve saldırı kullanımları bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel yapılardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın engel olma ile belirli müdahale ve ayrım gözetmeyen saldırı yapıları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başka bir şeyin önüne veya arasına girerek geçişini engellemesi ya da bir kişinin bir işe kendini sokup karşısına dikilmesidir. Belirli bir yapıda, karşılaşılan insanları ayrım gözetmeden öldürme veya yakalama anlamına uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık araya girerek başka bir varlığın geçişini veya ilerleyişini engeller.
Kişinin bir işe kendini sokması veya birinin karşısına dikilmesi olarak uygulanır.
Özel bir yapıda insanları karşılaşılan yönden ayrım gözetmeden öldürme veya yakalamayı anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların birleşik anlatımı, araya girerek engelleme çekirdeğini; işe müdahale etme ve karşılaşılan insanlara ayrım gözetmeden saldırma uzantılarıyla birlikte verir.

concept_gloss.text: araya girip engelleme ve karşısına dikilme
concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel engeli, müdahaleyi ve bunlara bağlı özel saldırı yapısını aynı çekirdekte toplar.

error_profile.preserves: Araya girme, engelleme ve karşısına çıkma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ayrım gözetmeyen öldürme veya yakalama yapısını açıkça söylemez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir varlığın geçişi fiziksel veya mecazi olarak engellendiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşıya çıkma ve engelleme ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: İşe kendini sokma ve özel saldırı kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: insanları ayrım gözetmeden öldürmek veya yakalamak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal araya girme, işe müdahale etme ve özel saldırı yapısını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal failin birini istediği eylemden alıkoymasına ve vazgeçirmesine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişinin veya şeyin hedefine ulaşmasını engelleme alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı yanı, fiziksel ya da mecazi olarak araya girip karşıya dikilmektir; komşu dalda araya yerleşme şart olmadan genel alıkoyma yeterlidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; araya girme koşulunu genel engellemeden ayıran komşu en yararlı karşılaştırma olarak seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اعترض الشيء إذا حال ومنع، وعرض العارض، والتعرض للناس، والاعتراض في الطريق أو الأمر، واستعراض الناس قتلا أو أخذا من أي وجه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه العرض الهادئ بمعنى الإظهار، ولا المعارضة بمعنى المقابلة بالمثل إلا إذا كان فيها حيلولة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: اعترض في الأمر إذا أدخل نفسه فيه (maqayis)؛ عرض القوم على السيف (ayn)؛ اعترض الشيء دون الشيء أي حال دونه (sihah)؛ كل مانع منعك فهو عارض (tahdhib)؛ اعترض الشيء في حلقه وقف فيه بالعرض (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişiden veya işten yüz çevirip uzaklaşmayı, yanını göstererek dönme imgesiyle açıkça destekler. Bu anlam görünme, sunma veya fiziksel en ölçüsü değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, dikkati ve yönelişi geri çekerek yüz çevirme eylemiyle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yüz çevirme anlamını verir; engelleme ya da gösterme yapıları eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiye veya konuya yönelmeyi bırakıp ondan yüz çevirmek, ilgiyi kesmek ve yanını dönerek uzaklaşmaktır.

facets.statement: Kişi, birinden veya bir konudan yönelişini geri çekip yüz çevirir.
Bedensel olarak yanını gösterip dönme, ilgiyi kesmenin görünür gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, bir kişiden veya işten yüz çevirip ilgiyi kesmektir; yanını dönme bu kopuşun bedensel görünümünü açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişiden veya konudan bedensel ya da tutumsal olarak uzaklaşmayı birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yönelişi geri çekme, yüz çevirme ve ilgiyi kesmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya konuyla ilgilenmeyi reddetme bağlamında doğal ve doğrudan karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel dönmeyi ve mecazi ilgisizleşmeyi birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: birinden yüz çevirmek, onunla ilgiyi kesmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal öznenin kendisinin yüz çevirip ilgisini kesmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal başkasını bir şeyden engelleyip uzaklaştıran ettirgen kullanımı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişi veya şeyden yönelişi kesip uzaklaşmayı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal öznenin kendi dönüşüne ve ilgisini çekmesine bağlıdır; komşu dal hem öznenin uzaklaşmasını hem de başka birini engelleyip uzaklaştırmasını içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; öznenin yüz çevirmesiyle başkasını uzaklaştırma arasındaki sınırı gösteren aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أعرض عن فلان أو عن الأمر أو بوجهه، والصد عنه، والتولي مبديا الجانب.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الظهور والإبراز، ولا مجرد العرض خلاف الطول.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أعرضت عن فلان وأعرضت عن هذا الأمر وأعرض بوجهه (maqayis)؛ الإعراض عن الشيء الصد عنه (sihah)؛ أعرض عني فمعناه ولى مبديا عرضه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi geniş anlamda karşı çıkmayı değil, birinin hizasında ilerlemeyi, yaptığına denk bir karşılık vermeyi, iki metni karşılaştırmayı ve mal değişimini destekler. Bu nedenle dal, genel muhalefet veya sözlü tartışma yerine karşılıklı denklik ve eşleştirme çevresinde tanımlanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Karşılıklılık veya denklik şarttır; sırf engelleme ve genel muhalefet bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hizada ilerleme çekirdeği ile metin karşılaştırma ve mal değişimi yapıları ayrı, fakat denklik ilişkisi altında tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Başkasının hizasında ilerlemek veya yaptığına denk bir eylemle karşılık vermek; belirli yapılarda iki metni karşılaştırmak ya da bir malı başka bir malla değişmektir.

facets.statement: İki taraf hareket veya eylem bakımından birbirinin hizasında ya da dengi olur.
İki metni yan yana getirip karşılaştırma, denklik ilişkisinin özel yapısıdır.
Bir malı başka bir mal karşılığında değiştirme, karşılıklı denk verme yapısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak alanı, iki tarafı hizada veya karşılıklı denk konuma getirmedir; hareket, eyleme karşılık verme, metin karşılaştırma ve değiş tokuş bunun farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.text: denk karşılık verme, karşılaştırma veya değişme
concept_gloss.applicability: Hareket ve eylem denkliğini, metin karşılaştırmasını ve mal değişimini ortak ilişkileriyle temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı denkliği ve üç temel gerçekleşmeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin yaptığına denk bir eylemle karşılık verme bağlamında doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemler arasındaki denklik ve karşılıklılığı korur.
error_profile.loses: Hizada ilerleme, metin karşılaştırma ve mal değişimi kullanımlarını vermez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: birinin hizasında gitmek veya yaptığına denk karşılık vermek
bir malı başka bir malla değiştirmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal hizada ilerleme, metin karşılaştırma ve mal değişimi yapılarını birlikte taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal eşlik, evlilikte denklik, savaşta denk güç ve ödüllendirme gibi daha geniş denklik alanlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da iki tarafın denkliği ve bir eyleme misliyle karşılık verilmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli karşılıklı eylem ve karşılaştırma yapılarına bağlıdır; komşu dal denklik ve eşdeğerlik durumunu daha genel bir ilişki olarak kurar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel denklik ile bu dalın yapı bağımlı karşılıklılığı arasındaki farkı en iyi gösteren aday seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عارضه في السير، وعارضه بمثل صنيعه، والمعارضة في الكتاب أو الكلام، والمبادلة بالمتاع أو الدابة، والمباراة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الاعتراض المانع إذا لم تكن مقابلة أو مماثلة، ولا التعريض غير الصريح.
branches.source_phrase_ar: عارضت فلانا في السير إذا سرت حياله وعارضته مثل ما صنع (maqayis)؛ عارضته في المسير وعارضت كتابي بكتابه (sihah)؛ عارضته بمتاع أو دابة معارضة إذا بادلته به وعارضت كتابي بكتابه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiye sonradan gelen hastalık veya olay ile kalıcılığı olmayan durumu açıkça birleştirir. Beklenmedik ok ve ansızın doğan bağlanma, bu geliş ve geçicilik çekirdeğinin özel yapılarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın ayırıcı niteliği sonradan ve çoğu kez beklenmedik biçimde ortaya çıkma ile kalıcı olmamadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Geçici olay çekirdeği ile beklenmedik ok ve ansızın bağlanma yapıları birbirine karıştırılmadan tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyde sonradan ortaya çıkan ve kalıcı olmayan durum veya niteliktir. Kişi bağlamında hastalık veya başa gelen olay; belirli yapılarda ise kaynağı bilinmeden gelen bir ok ya da ansızın doğan gönül bağını anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir durum veya nitelik sonradan ortaya çıkar ve kalıcı değildir.
Kaynağı bilinmeden isabet eden ok, beklenmedik gelişin somut örneğidir.
Birine ansızın gönül bağlama, hazırlıksız ortaya çıkma özelliğine bağlı bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, sonradan ortaya çıkan ve kalıcılığı olmayan durum veya niteliktir; hastalık, kişinin başına gelen olay, beklenmedik isabet ve ansızın bağlanma bu çekirdeğin farklı bağlamlarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: sonradan ortaya çıkan kalıcı olmayan durum veya nitelik
concept_gloss.applicability: Genel durum ve nitelik çekirdeğini sonradan ortaya çıkma ve kalıcı olmama koşullarıyla temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Sonradan ortaya çıkma ve kalıcı olmama çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ok isabeti ve ansızın gönül bağlama yapılarını açıkça belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişiye sonradan gelen ateş veya hastalık bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sonradan gelen ve kalıcı olmayan hastalık yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Hastalık dışındaki olayları ve özel beklenmedik yapıları kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sonradan gelen geçici hastalık veya olay
nereden atıldığı bilinmeden isabet eden ok

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal başa gelen olayın özellikle bela, felaket veya nöbet oluşuna odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: başa gelen olay ve geçici durum
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin başına gelen hastalık veya olumsuz olay alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal olayın sonradan belirmesi ve kalıcı olmamasını öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise olayın musibet niteliğini kurar ve geçicilik şartı taşımaz.

branches.branch_image_ar: العرض الطارئ الذي يعرض ثم يزول
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العارض من الحمى أو السقم، وأحداث الدهر، والمرض والموت ونحوهما، وسهم عرض، والحب أو الرأي الذي يقع بغتة، والعرض الكلامي لما لا ثبات له.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه متاع الدنيا من حيث هو مال أو بدل إلا إذا أريد طروؤه وعدم ثباته.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العرض من أحداث الدهر كالمرض ونحوه (maqayis)؛ عرضه عارض من الحمى ونحوها (sihah)؛ العرض الأمر يعرض للرجل يبتلى به وسهم عرض (tahdhib)؛ العرض ما لا يكون له ثبات (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dünya malı, nakit dışı eşya ve kolay elde edilen dünyevi payı açıkça destekler. Bir hak yerine verilen mal da bu maddi değer alanındaki belirli bir değişim yapısıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal maddi dünya malı ve karşılık olarak verilen eşya ile sınırlıdır; geçici olay anlamı ancak tarihsel çağrışım düzeyindedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dünya malı ve nakit dışı eşya çekirdeği, hak yerine mal verme yapısından ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Dünyaya ait elde edilebilir mal, eşya veya pay; özellikle nakit para dışında kalan ticari eşyadır. Belirli bir yapıda, bir alacak ya da hak yerine verilen malı anlatır.

facets.statement: Elde edilebilir dünyevi mal, eşya veya payı belirtir.
Nakit para dışında kalan ticari eşyalar bu dalın özel alanıdır.
Bir hak veya alacak yerine eşya verme, malın karşılık işlevine bağlı bir yapıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, elde edilebilir dünya malını ve özellikle nakit dışı eşyayı kapsar; kolay kazanç ve hak yerine eşya verme bu maddi değer alanına bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.text: dünya malı, nakit dışı eşya ve mal karşılığı
concept_gloss.applicability: Genel dünyevi payı, ticari eşyayı ve hak yerine verilen malı birlikte açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: Maddi payı, nakit dışı eşyayı ve karşılık işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nakit para dışında alınıp satılan mallar söz konusu olduğunda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Nakit dışı mal ve eşya yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel dünyevi payı ve hak yerine mal verme yapısını kapsamaz.
